{
  "title": "I.S.T.A.R Facilities",
  "language": "en",
  "recommended_level": "Woefully Unprepared 7th level characters",
  "hook": "A flashing light goes off in the I.S.T.A.R facilities, alerting the party to a problem with the budget overrun.",
  "npcs": [
    {
      "name": "Dread Lord Riavi",
      "role": "Designated temporary leader of the Black Network while Riavi is away"
    },
    {
      "name": "Guild Office Manager Kleff",
      "role": null
    },
    {
      "name": "Zhentarim Underlings",
      "role": "Approach the party to alert them to the flashing light on the control board."
    }
  ],
  "locations": [
    "Intern Selection Training and Ranking facility",
    "Testing Room 1",
    "Testing Room 2",
    "Testing Room 3",
    "Emomel's Memorial Acid Pit Training Room",
    "Trust Falls, Performance Reviews, and Contract Negotiations Room"
  ],
  "threats": [
    "Flesh golem version of Kleff",
    "Spider-bees",
    "Spider wolves",
    "Ghost sharks",
    "Skeletal intern uniforms",
    "Kleff (in disguise)"
  ],
  "rewards": [
    "Medallions based on the value of collected treasure",
    "Gold star for the player who gathers the most treasure",
    "Gold construction paper star for the player who gathers the most treasure",
    "Small Dread Lord Riavi action figure for the player who uses the chandelier",
    "Gold, silver, copper, and steel medallions based on the value of collected treasure"
  ]
}
